dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can bring you to see a doctor.

dialogues.speaker: Raku
dialogues.text: Eh? Uh... There's no need, I went to see a doctor long ago. I mean, it's a serious injury. How could I have not gone to see a doctor, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Raku
dialogues.text: The doctor said that I needed to convalesce. That I needed a, ah, quiet environment and some time.

dialogues.speaker: Raku
dialogues.text: Anyway, don't you have better things to do? You look like a busy person. I'm sure you don't have time to waste here with me!
